title: From his first goal at 17 to 'GOAT' at 39: How Messi built his legacy year by year
summary: As Lionel Messi turns 39, his career remains a testament to extraordinary longevity. From scoring his first senior goal at 17 to surpassing 900 career goals, the Argentine has continued to thrive well beyond his prime years.
